# Orientation Note for profiling_sandbox/typer/

## Main Entry Points
The main entry points for the Typer CLI framework are defined in `main.py` starting at line 12 with the `Typer` class. This class serves as the central interface for creating and configuring CLI applications.

## Core Data Structures
The core data structures used throughout the framework are defined in `models.py`:
- `Context` (line 12): Represents the execution context of a CLI command
- `FileText`, `FileTextWrite`, `FileBinaryRead`, etc. (lines 15-17): File handling classes for different I/O operations
- `CommandFunctionType` and related types (line 23): Type definitions for command functions

## Error Handling
Error handling is implemented in `core.py` with the `except_hook` function starting at line 12. This function provides custom exception handling that:
1. Checks for TYPER_STANDARD_TRACEBACK environment variable
2. Uses rich library for pretty exception formatting when available
3. Filters out internal library frames from the traceback
4. Provides different output formats based on configuration

The error handling system works with `DeveloperExceptionConfig` to control:
- Pretty exception enable/disable status
- Short vs full traceback display
- Internal library path filtering

All these components work together to provide a consistent and user-friendly CLI experience while maintaining robust error handling and type safety.
